subject: english
question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

A person who is against the use of violence and war to settle disputes
solution:
The correct answer is: **Pacifist**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 

__
 
• A **pacifist **is someone who opposes the use of violence and war to resolve conflicts. (कोई व्यक्ति जो संघर्षों को सुलझाने के लिए हिंसा और युद्ध के उपयोग का विरोध करता है)

 
 
• **Example**: *The pacifist's beliefs promote nonviolent solutions to conflicts.*
 
 
 
• The word comes from the Latin word "**pax**," meaning peace.
 
• Pacifists may advocate for nonviolent resistance, diplomacy, or other peaceful means of conflict resolution.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Fatalist**: Someone who believes that events are predetermined and inevitable, often leading to a sense of resignation or acceptance. (कोई व्यक्ति जो मानता है कि घटनाएँ पूर्वनिर्धारित और अपरिहार्य हैं, तो अक्सर त्यागपत्र या स्वीकृति की भावना उत्पन्न होती है)
 
• **Hedonist**: Someone who seeks pleasure and enjoyment, often at the expense of others or long-term consequences. (कोई व्यक्ति जो अक्सर दूसरों या दीर्घकालिक परिणामों की कीमत पर सुख और आनंद चाहता है)
 
• **Misogynist**: Someone who hates or discriminates against women. (कोई व्यक्ति जो महिलाओं से नफरत करता है या उनके खिलाफ भेदभाव करता है)
